protocol.base: fixed context forest; source station OOF predictions
protocol.training_loss: weighted_cell_raw_mae; fixed global source mean weight
protocol.nonfinite_policy: fail; no skipped update or upper clipping
protocol.initialization: provided original spatial/GRU/decay; zero scalar head
protocol.spatial_mode: eval throughout; empty edges; frozen input normalization
protocol.clock_input_changed: decay scalar only; raw M1 age unchanged
protocol.flow_window: start12; visible discharge reset0; otherwise increment cap12; valid steps only
protocol.clock_scope: queried causal window only; no external history, labels or scalar-head extras
protocol.effective_capacity_note: unseen-neutral removes age variation at never-observed stations; allocated weights unchanged
protocol.clock_interpretation: shared recurrent-state decay; not physical transport or residence time
